title: 第一卷 第22章 将计就计
novel_title: 重回九八：我在小渔村兴风作浪
content_zh:
刘表没皮没脸惯了，即便李华是这个态度，他还要跟着。

    “华哥，别介啊。”

    “三个和尚挑水喝的道理我懂，但咱又不是和尚，你放心，这赚钱的买卖，我绝对不会偷奸耍滑。”

    “你就带上我吧。”

    “俗话说一个好汉三个帮。”

    “阿青多笨啊，一点眼力见都没有，我绝对比他强多了。”

    阿青嘴笨。

    听刘表这么说，心里面不爽，只是瞪了刘表一眼，却也没有说什么。

    李华看在眼里，心里跟明镜似的。

    刘表的嘴皮子的确很溜，上辈子他就是被这小子各种哄骗，越陷越深，最终烂在泥泞里，爬不出来了。

    如今。

    他自然不可能重蹈覆辙。

    离刘表这种人越远越好！

    阿青是有些笨手笨脚，脑子也有时候转不来弯。

    正因为如此，人非常实在。

    所以他愿意带着阿青一起，一起做事，非常踏实。

    “华哥，华哥，走，那么快干嘛？等等我。”

    “那么多海参，你是在哪里抓到的？”

    “真是在礁石滩吗？”

    “你不会故意说一个错的地点误导大家吧？”

    刘表的小眼睛里满是算计。

    李华说道：“你以为我跟你一样。”

    “我们走的时候遇到你爸了。”

    “不信就回去问你爸。”

    刘表问道：“那么多海参，你们都抓完了吗？”

    李华说道：“那谁知道。”

    “我们是沿着岩壁，跟着潮水往下走，边走边抓。”

    “明天退大潮，只要跟着潮水往下走，应该能抓到海参。”

    刘表一听，眼睛顿时亮了起来：“华哥，那明天咱们一起啊。”

    李华：“再说吧。”

    “赚钱实在是太累了。”

    “我得好好歇一歇。”

    刘表笑着点头，应和道：“对对对，赚了那么多钱，是该潇洒享受。”

    “那我就不打扰你了。”

    说完，他转身就往家里跑。

    到了家里，正好遇到他爸回来，刘丰鱼得知李华赚了大钱，瞪眼说道：“你晓得天天跟着李华混，今天死哪去了？”

    刘表哪里敢说实话，讪讪说道：“爸，我已经打听清楚了。”

    “明天退大潮，咱们爷俩去礁石滩抓海参。”
content_en:
Liu Biao was used to being shameless, so even if Li Hua had this attitude, he would still follow him.

    "Brother Hua, don't bother me."

    "I understand the principle of three monks carrying water, but we are not monks. Don't worry, I will never cheat on you in this profitable business."

    "Just take me with you."

    "As the saying goes, a good man has three gangs."

    "Ah Qing is so stupid. He has no eyesight at all. I am definitely much better than him."

    Ah Qing is stupid.

    Hearing what Liu Biao said, I felt unhappy. I just glared at Liu Biao but didn't say anything.

    Li Hua saw it and felt like a mirror in his heart.

    Liu Biao was indeed very smooth-talking. In his previous life, he had been deceived by this boy in various ways, sinking deeper and deeper into the mud, and finally rotting in the mud, unable to climb out.

    now.

    Of course he couldn't make the same mistake again.

    The further away you are from people like Liu Biao, the better!

    Ah Qing is a bit clumsy and sometimes has trouble turning his head.

    Because of this, people are very real.

    So he is willing to take Ah Qing with him to do things together, which is very practical.

    "Brother Hua, Brother Hua, let's go, what are you doing so quickly? Wait for me."

    "Where did you catch so many sea cucumbers?"

    "Is it really on the reef beach?"

    "You wouldn't deliberately mislead everyone by saying a wrong location, would you?"

    Liu Biao's little eyes were full of calculations.

    Li Hua said: "You think I am the same as you."

    "We met your dad when we were leaving."

    "If you don't believe me, go back and ask your dad."

    Liu Biao asked: "Have you caught all the sea cucumbers?"

    Li Hua said: "Who knows."

    "We walked along the rock wall and followed the tide, grabbing as we went."

    "The tide will go out tomorrow. As long as you follow the tide and go down, you should be able to catch sea cucumbers."

    When Liu Biao heard this, his eyes suddenly lit up: "Brother Hua, let's go together tomorrow."

    Li Hua: "Let's talk about it later."

    "Making money is really tiring."

    "I need to take a good rest."

    Liu Biao smiled and nodded, agreeing: "Yes, yes, after making so much money, you should enjoy it freely."

    "Then I won't disturb you."

    After saying that, he turned around and ran home.

    When he got home, his father came back. When Liu Fengyu learned that Li Hua had made a lot of money, he glared and said, "You know you follow Li Hua around every day, but where did you die today?"

    Liu Biao didn't dare to tell the truth, so he said: "Dad, I have already found out everything."

    "When the tide goes out tomorrow, we will go to the rocky beach to catch sea cucumbers."
title_en: Volume 1 Chapter 22 Take advantage of the situation
